chapter: In The Mood, Rendezvous and Capitol
title: Rene Hall comes to Dallas to arrange between Earl Hines jobs
summary: When Earl Hines is idle, Fields sends for Rene Hall to arrange for him in Dallas in the 1940s.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well, all along Rene Hall and I had been very close friends and he did arrangements for me even after he was out of the band. One time he was with Earl Hines band and Earl had--you see the big bands had slow times as well as the little ones, and I had a nice run down in Dallas, and I was on a location and so I called up Rene and told him what's Earl doing?
He said we've been off for a while. I said let me send for you to come down to Dallas. He came down and worked a while with me arranging and everything and went on back--
That was in the forties still.
